$comment: Source of truth for the BluesFuse Preamp presets. Edit this file and run 'make presets' to regenerate plugins/BluesFuse/Presets.hpp (DPF programs, exported to LV2 presets.ttl/manifest.ttl and to VST3/CLAP). The parameter order below must match the Parameters enum in DistrhoPluginInfo.h (gain, volume, treble, bass, mid, comp, model); program 0 must equal 'defaults'.
